name: resetInitViewPos
description: Restores the initial viewing position and orientation as configured at startup. Can be called at any time to return to the default view.
example:
// Return to the configured default view
StelMovementMgr.resetInitViewPos();

name: toggleMountMode
description: Toggles between equatorial and alt-azimuthal mount modes. If currently equatorial, switches to alt-azimuthal, and vice versa.

name: setEquatorialMount
description: Switches between equatorial mount and alt-azimuthal mount modes. Equatorial mode follows the celestial sphere rotation; alt-azimuthal mode is fixed to the horizon. The setting is saved to the configuration file.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true for equatorial mount, false for alt-azimuthal

compatibility.notes: Saved to navigation/viewing_mode. Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'equatorialMount' (READ getEquatorialMount, WRITE setEquatorialMount).

name: setFlagTracking
description: Enables or disables tracking of the selected object. When enabled, the camera follows the selected object automatically. Default parameter value is true.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable tracking, false to disable. Defaults to true.

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'tracking' (READ getFlagTracking, WRITE setFlagTracking).

name: getFlagTracking
description: Returns whether the view is currently tracking the selected object.
returnDescription: true if tracking is enabled, false otherwise

name: setFlagLockEquPos
description: Locks or unlocks the equatorial position. When locked, the view remains fixed in equatorial coordinates as time passes.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to lock equatorial position, false to unlock

name: getFlagLockEquPos
description: Returns whether the equatorial position is currently locked.
returnDescription: true if equatorial position is locked, false otherwise
example:
var locked = StelMovementMgr.getFlagLockEquPos();
core.debug("Equatorial locked: " + locked);

name: panView
description: Pans the view instantly by adding azimuth and altitude offsets to the current direction. Changes are instantaneous (no animation).

parameters.name: deltaAz
parameters.description: Azimuth change in radians

parameters.name: deltaAlt
parameters.description: Altitude change in radians

example:
// Pan 10 degrees east and 5 degrees up
StelMovementMgr.panView(10 * Math.PI/180, 5 * Math.PI/180);

name: setAutoMoveDuration
description: Sets the duration of automatic movement animations in seconds.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Duration in seconds

name: getAutoMoveDuration
description: Returns the duration of automatic movement animations in seconds.
returnDescription: Auto-move duration in seconds
example:
var dur = StelMovementMgr.getAutoMoveDuration();
core.debug("Auto-move duration: " + dur);

name: setFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection
description: Sets whether auto-zoom out should reset the viewing direction to the initial position. When true, calling autoZoomOut() with full=true will return the view to the configured initial direction. The setting is saved to the configuration file.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to reset direction on zoom out, false to preserve the current direction

compatibility.notes: Saved to navigation/auto_zoom_out_resets_direction. Emits flagAutoZoomOutResetsDirectionChanged signal when the value changes.

name: getFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection
description: Returns whether auto-zoom out resets the viewing direction to the initial position.
returnDescription: true if direction resets on zoom out, false otherwise
example:
var reset = StelMovementMgr.getFlagAutoZoomOutResetsDirection();
core.debug("Auto-zoom out resets direction: " + reset);

name: getFlagEnableZoomKeys
description: Returns whether keyboard zoom keys (PageUp/PageDown) are enabled.
returnDescription: true if zoom keys are enabled, false otherwise
example:
var enabled = StelMovementMgr.getFlagEnableZoomKeys();
core.debug("Zoom keys enabled: " + enabled);

name: setFlagEnableZoomKeys
description: Enables or disables keyboard zoom keys (PageUp/PageDown).

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable zoom keys, false to disable

name: getFlagEnableMoveKeys
description: Returns whether keyboard arrow keys for view movement are enabled.
returnDescription: true if movement keys are enabled, false otherwise
example:
var enabled = StelMovementMgr.getFlagEnableMoveKeys();
core.debug("Move keys enabled: " + enabled);

name: setFlagEnableMoveKeys
description: Enables or disables keyboard arrow keys for view movement.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable movement keys, false to disable

name: getFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge
description: Returns whether view movement activates when the mouse cursor reaches the screen edge.
returnDescription: true if edge movement is enabled, false otherwise
example:
var enabled = StelMovementMgr.getFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge();
core.debug("Edge movement enabled: " + enabled);

name: setFlagEnableMoveAtScreenEdge
description: Enables or disables view movement when the mouse cursor reaches the screen edge.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable edge movement, false to disable

name: getFlagEnableMouseNavigation
description: Returns whether mouse dragging for view navigation is enabled.
returnDescription: true if mouse navigation is enabled, false otherwise
example:
var enabled = StelMovementMgr.getFlagEnableMouseNavigation();
core.debug("Mouse navigation enabled: " + enabled);

name: setFlagEnableMouseNavigation
description: Enables or disables mouse dragging for view navigation.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable mouse navigation, false to disable

name: getFlagEnableMouseZooming
description: Returns whether mouse wheel zooming is enabled.
returnDescription: true if mouse zooming is enabled, false otherwise
example:
var enabled = StelMovementMgr.getFlagEnableMouseZooming();
core.debug("Mouse zooming enabled: " + enabled);

name: setFlagEnableMouseZooming
description: Enables or disables mouse wheel zooming.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable mouse zooming, false to disable

name: getFlagIndicationMountMode
description: Returns whether the on-screen indicator for the current mount mode is shown.
returnDescription: true if mount mode indicator is shown, false otherwise
example:
var shown = StelMovementMgr.getFlagIndicationMountMode();
core.debug("Mount mode indicator shown: " + shown);

name: setFlagIndicationMountMode
description: Shows or hides the on-screen indicator for the current mount mode.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to show indicator, false to hide

name: moveToJ2000
signature: moveToJ2000(Vec3d aim, Vec3d aimUp, float moveDuration, ZoomingMode zooming)
description: Smoothly moves the view to a specific J2000 equatorial coordinate. The aimUp vector defines the orientation of the view; it may need to be exact when looking into the zenith or pole. Parameters moveDuration and zooming are optional.

parameters.name: aim
parameters.description: Target J2000 direction vector. Construct with new V3d(x,y,z) or new V3d('0h','0d')

parameters.name: aimUp
parameters.description: Up vector for the target view (usually (0,0,1))

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the animation in seconds

parameters.name: zooming
parameters.description: Zoom mode: -1 = ZoomOut, 0 = ZoomNone, 1 = ZoomIn

compatibility.notes: Vec3d arguments must be wrapped with new V3d(...) on Qt6. core.moveToRaDecJ2000() provides a simpler signature.

name: moveToAltAzi
signature: moveToAltAzi(Vec3d aim, Vec3d aimUp, float moveDuration, ZoomingMode zooming)
description: Smoothly moves the view to a specific Altitude/Azimuth coordinate. Only works when the mount mode is Alt-Azimuthal. Parameters moveDuration and zooming are optional.

parameters.name: aim
parameters.description: Target Alt/Az direction vector

parameters.name: aimUp
parameters.description: Up vector for the target view

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the animation in seconds

parameters.name: zooming
parameters.description: Zoom mode: -1 = ZoomOut, 0 = ZoomNone, 1 = ZoomIn

compatibility.notes: Only works in Alt-Azimuth mount mode. Vec3d arguments must be wrapped with new V3d(...) on Qt6.

name: zoomTo
description: Smoothly zooms to a target field of view over a specified duration. Parameter zoomDuration is optional (default 1.0 s).

parameters.name: aimFov
parameters.description: Target field of view in degrees

parameters.name: zoomDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the zoom animation in seconds. Use 0 for an instant change.

name: getCurrentFov
description: Returns the current field of view in degrees.
returnDescription: Field of view in degrees

name: getInitFov
description: Returns the initial default field of view in degrees, used when resetting the view.
returnDescription: Initial FOV in degrees
example:
var initFov = StelMovementMgr.getInitFov();
core.debug("Initial FOV: " + initFov + '°');

name: setInitFov
description: Sets the initial field of view value, used when resetting the view. Saved to the configuration file.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: Initial FOV in degrees

name: getInitViewingDirection
description: Returns the initial viewing direction in alt-azimuthal coordinates. The result is a Vec3d and MUST be wrapped in new V3d(...) before reading components on Qt6.
returnDescription: Initial viewing direction vector (wrap in new V3d(...) to inspect)

name: setInitViewDirectionToCurrent
description: Sets the initial viewing direction to the current view direction and saves it to the configuration file.
example:
StelMovementMgr.setInitViewDirectionToCurrent();
core.debug("New default view direction saved");

name: getViewDirectionJ2000
description: Returns the current viewing direction in the equatorial J2000 frame. The result is a Vec3d and MUST be wrapped in new V3d(...) before reading components on Qt6.
returnDescription: Current view direction vector in J2000 frame (wrap in new V3d(...) to inspect)

name: setViewDirectionJ2000
description: Sets the current viewing direction in the equatorial J2000 frame. The change is instantaneous.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: View direction vector in J2000 coordinates

compatibility.notes: Vec3d argument must be wrapped with new V3d(...) on Qt6.

name: setMaxFov
description: Sets the maximum field of view in degrees. This is the hard limit imposed by the current projection.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum FOV in degrees

name: getMaxFov
description: Returns the maximum field of view in degrees imposed by the current projection.
returnDescription: Maximum FOV in degrees
example:
var maxFov = StelMovementMgr.getMaxFov();
core.debug("Max FOV: " + maxFov + '°');

name: getMinFov
description: Returns the minimum field of view in degrees (default: 5 arcseconds).
returnDescription: Minimum FOV in degrees
example:
var minFov = StelMovementMgr.getMinFov();
core.debug("Min FOV: " + minFov + '°');

name: autoZoomIn
description: Automatically zooms in on the currently selected object. This is the action typically bound to the '/' key.

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration for the zoom animation in seconds

parameters.name: allowManualZoom
parameters.description: If true, allows additional manual zooming beyond the automatic level

example:
core.selectObjectByName('Mars', true);
StelMovementMgr.autoZoomIn(1.5, true);

name: autoZoomOut
description: Automatically zooms out, either to a satellite system view or to the initial view. This is the action typically bound to the '\\' key.

parameters.name: moveDuration
parameters.description: Duration for the zoom animation in seconds

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: If true, zooms out fully to the initial view even from a satellite view

example:
StelMovementMgr.autoZoomOut(1.0, false);
StelMovementMgr.autoZoomOut(2.0, true);

name: deselection
description: Deselects the currently selected object.
example: StelMovementMgr.deselection();

name: reSelectLastObject
description: Re-selects the last object that was selected.
example: StelMovementMgr.reSelectLastObject();

name: getAimFov
description: If currently zooming, returns the target FOV; otherwise returns the current FOV in degrees.
returnDescription: Target FOV if zooming, current FOV otherwise (degrees)
example:
var aimFov = StelMovementMgr.getAimFov();
core.debug("Aim FOV: " + aimFov + '°');

name: turnRight
description: Starts or stops continuous panning to the right (east direction, or decreasing RA in equatorial mode). Turning continues until turnRight(false) or turnLeft(any) is called. Note: it does not stop when the script terminates.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

compatibility.notes: Use panView() for precise control of view movements.

name: turnLeft
description: Starts or stops continuous panning to the left (west direction, or increasing RA in equatorial mode). Turning continues until turnLeft(false) or turnRight(any) is called.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: turnUp
description: Starts or stops continuous panning upward (toward zenith or north celestial pole). Movement halts at the target but the command remains active until turnUp(false) or turnDown(any) is called.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: turnDown
description: Starts or stops continuous panning downward (toward nadir or south celestial pole). Movement halts at the target but the command remains active until turnDown(false) or turnUp(any) is called.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start, false to stop

name: moveSlow
description: Enables or disables slow movement mode (reduces movement speed to 20%).

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true for slow movement, false for normal speed

name: zoomIn
description: Starts or stops continuous zooming in (increasing magnification). Zooming pauses when the minimum FOV (5 arcseconds) is reached but the command remains active until zoomIn(false) or zoomOut(any) is called.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start zooming in, false to stop

name: zoomOut
description: Starts or stops continuous zooming out (decreasing magnification). Zooming pauses when the maximum FOV (235°) is reached but the command remains active until zoomOut(false) or zoomIn(any) is called.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start zooming out, false to stop

name: smoothPan
signature: smoothPan(double deltaX, double deltaY, double ptime, bool s)
description: Starts or stops smooth panning by a predetermined amount. ptime is the time for ONE step of delta, not the total duration. Panning speed is deltaX/ptime and deltaY/ptime (degrees per second).

parameters.name: deltaX
parameters.description: Horizontal pan amount in degrees

parameters.name: deltaY
parameters.description: Vertical pan amount in degrees

parameters.name: ptime
parameters.description: Time for one step of delta, in seconds

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: true to start panning, false to stop

compatibility.notes: ptime is the step duration, not the total animation duration.

name: lookEast
description: Instantly points the view toward the eastern horizon. If zero is true, centers exactly on the horizon; if false, keeps the current altitude.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep current altitude

example:
StelMovementMgr.lookEast(false);
StelMovementMgr.lookEast(true);

name: lookWest
description: Instantly points the view toward the western horizon. If zero is true, centers exactly on the horizon; if false, keeps the current altitude.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep current altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookWest(true);

name: lookNorth
description: Instantly points the view toward the northern horizon. If zero is true, centers exactly on the horizon; if false, keeps the current altitude.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep current altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookNorth(true);

name: lookSouth
description: Instantly points the view toward the southern horizon. If zero is true, centers exactly on the horizon; if false, keeps the current altitude.

parameters.name: zero
parameters.description: true to center on horizon, false to keep current altitude

example: StelMovementMgr.lookSouth(true);

name: lookZenith
description: Instantly points the view straight up (zenith), turning the specified azimuth's horizon to the bottom of the screen. The custom azi parameter is only valid for alt-azimuthal mount mode.

parameters.name: azi
parameters.description: South-centered azimuth (default 180 = South, 90 = East, etc.)

compatibility.notes: Custom azi only valid for alt-azimuthal mount mode. A warning is printed in equatorial mode if azi != 180.

example:
StelMovementMgr.lookZenith();
StelMovementMgr.lookZenith(90.0);

name: lookNadir
description: Instantly points the view straight down (nadir), turning the specified azimuth's horizon to the top of the screen. The custom azi parameter is only valid for alt-azimuthal mount mode.

parameters.name: azi
parameters.description: South-centered azimuth (default 180 = South, 90 = East, etc.)

compatibility.notes: Custom azi only valid for alt-azimuthal mount mode.

example: StelMovementMgr.lookNadir();

name: lookTowardsNCP
description: Instantly points the view toward the North Celestial Pole.
example: StelMovementMgr.lookTowardsNCP();

name: lookTowardsSCP
description: Instantly points the view toward the South Celestial Pole.
example: StelMovementMgr.lookTowardsSCP();

name: moveViewport
signature: moveViewport(double offsetX, double offsetY, float duration)
description: Animates the viewport offset, allowing the view center to be shifted. Useful for planetarium domes or panoramic displays. Offsets are clamped to [-50, 50] percent. Only vertical viewport is really meaningful.

parameters.name: offsetX
parameters.description: Horizontal offset percentage (-50 to 50)

parameters.name: offsetY
parameters.description: Vertical offset percentage (-50 to 50)

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Animation duration in seconds (0 = instant)

example:
StelMovementMgr.moveViewport(0, 20, 2.0);
StelMovementMgr.moveViewport(0, 0, 0);

name: setMountMode
description:
Sets the current mount type defining the reference frame in which head movements occur.
- 0 = MountAltAzimuthal (horizon-based)
- 1 = MountEquinoxEquatorial (equatorial equinox)

parameters.name: m
parameters.description: Mount mode: 0 = AltAzimuthal, 1 = EquinoxEquatorial

compatibility.notes: The MountMode enum currently has only two values. Galactic/Supergalactic are not implemented.

name: getMountMode
description: Returns the current mount type: 0 = AltAzimuthal, 1 = EquinoxEquatorial.
returnDescription: Current mount mode (0 or 1)
example:
var mode = StelMovementMgr.getMountMode();
core.debug("Mount mode: " + mode);

name: getEquatorialMount
description: Returns whether the mount mode is equatorial (true) or alt-azimuthal (false).
returnDescription: true for equatorial mount, false for alt-azimuthal

name: setInhibitAllAutomoves
description: Inhibits all automatic movements (tracking, auto-centering, etc.). Useful for planetarium setups where manual control should be absolute. Designed for use in startup.ssc.

parameters.name: inhibit
parameters.description: true to inhibit all automoves, false to allow

example:
StelMovementMgr.setInhibitAllAutomoves(true);
StelMovementMgr.setInhibitAllAutomoves(false);

name: getViewportOffsetTarget
description: Returns the targeted viewport offset as a Vec2d. The result MUST be wrapped in new V3d(...) or accessed as a two-component vector on Qt6.
returnDescription: Target viewport offset (x, y) as percentages

name: getViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget
description: Returns the targeted horizontal viewport offset percentage.
returnDescription: Target horizontal offset percentage (-50 to 50)
example:
var x = StelMovementMgr.getViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget();
core.debug('X target: ' + x + '%');

name: getViewportVerticalOffsetTarget
description: Returns the targeted vertical viewport offset percentage.
returnDescription: Target vertical offset percentage (-50 to 50)
example:
var y = StelMovementMgr.getViewportVerticalOffsetTarget();
core.debug('Y target: ' + y + '%');

name: setViewportHorizontalOffsetTarget
description: Sets the target horizontal viewport offset percentage instantly (no animation). Calls moveViewport(f, currentVertical).

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Horizontal offset percentage (-50 to 50)

name: setViewportVerticalOffsetTarget
description: Sets the target vertical viewport offset percentage instantly (no animation). Calls moveViewport(currentHorizontal, f).

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Vertical offset percentage (-50 to 50)

name: setUserMaxFov
description: Sets the user-configured maximum field of view limit. Useful for planetarium domes where FOV should never exceed 180°. Saved to the configuration file.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum FOV in degrees (1 to 360)

compatibility.notes: Saved to navigation/max_fov. Affects zoom operations but not setFov() directly.

name: getUserMaxFov
description: Returns the user-configured maximum field of view limit in degrees.
returnDescription: User max FOV in degrees
example:
var maxFov = StelMovementMgr.getUserMaxFov();
core.debug('User max FOV: ' + maxFov + '°');

name: setFov
description: Sets the current field of view in degrees instantly (no animation). Values are clamped between minFov and maxFov. If the current projection is ProjectionCylinderFill, the FOV is forced to 180°.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Field of view in degrees

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'currentFov' (READ getCurrentFov, WRITE setFov). Clamped between minFov and maxFov (projection-dependent), NOT userMaxFov.
